summary: Air forces loyal to Khalifa Haftar attacked positions in Tripoli controlled by a faction of the Islamist-leaning militia Operation Dawn for the second time within a week, members of his group said; Operation Dawn is comprised of fighters mostly from Misrata who have been fighting a militia group from Zintan, with fighting this year over parts of Tripoli reportedly centered around the airport for several weeks. The attack follows a similar one on the night of August 17–18, and countries including Egypt, France and the United States have denied involvement while the Libyan Government has opened an investigation. After Monday’s attack a spokesman for the militia said they were not abandoning their positions and that fighters from other areas were joining from Mosrata, a political adviser to General Haftar told Sky News that escalation by the militias would be met with escalation, Haftar backed Zintan in May, the central government is now working from Tobruk, and Haftar’s forces are reported to have also attacked militias in Benghazi.
